features.description: Declarative harness-profile schema + registry describing a local agent harness: name, detect command/path, workspace location, MCP wiring target, and a safe-action allowlist. Ships starter profiles for OpenClaw and Hermes. Generic by construction — no harness-specific branching in the loader.
steps: Define harness-profile schema (name, detect, workspace, mcp_target, safe_actions[])
Validation: reject malformed profiles; unknown harness is a clean no-op
features.acceptance: A new harness is supported by adding a profile file alone (no loader change); malformed profiles are rejected with a clear error; OpenClaw + Hermes profiles load and validate. Tests cover load/validate/registry.

features.description: `dontpanic harness detect` — read-only detection that reports which profiled harnesses are installed locally (via each profile's detect rule). No mutation, no execution.
steps: Implement detection running each profile's detect rule safely
Absent harness → reported not-installed, never an error
features.acceptance: Detection reports installed/not-installed per profiled harness without mutating anything or executing harness code; --format json validates; absent harness is a clean negative.

features.description: Command-surface bridge: for a detected harness, generate the config that points it at DontPanic's EXISTING surface (`agent brief|commands|guide`, `mcp serve`) per its profile — reusing shipped modules (agent_surface, command_guidance, agent_manifest, mcp), not building a new wrapper.
steps: Generate harness-side config (e.g. MCP endpoint + brief/commands references) from a profile
Reuse agent_surface/command_guidance/mcp serve; add no parallel surface
Enforce the profile's safe-action allowlist at the bridge boundary
Tests: generated config references only allowlisted actions + the shipped surface
features.acceptance: For a detected harness, the bridge emits config wiring it to the shipped agent/MCP surface, exposing only allowlisted safe actions; no new command wrapper is introduced. Verified by tests asserting reuse + allowlist enforcement.

features.description: Human-required routing: when a harness invokes an action needing approval, credentials, or deploy, the bridge emits a dashboard ActionItem (requires_human=true) with exact command + consequence + reversibility instead of executing it. Keeps the human-in-the-loop boundary intact for harness-driven flows.
steps: Classify harness-invoked actions: safe-auto vs human-required
Human-required → emit ActionItem (requires_human=true) via the shipped spine, do not execute
Tests: safe action proceeds; human-required action routes to dashboard, never executes
features.acceptance: A harness-invoked safe action proceeds; an approval/credential/deploy action emits a dashboard ActionItem (requires_human=true) and is NOT executed by the harness; routed items render consistently and leak no secrets.
